The pipeline itself was restored and instrumented under sn-pipeline-recovery: attempt-budgeted refinement, write-boundary attachment guards, ISN locus typing, and typical-bill cost admission are live.
sprints.summary: Four of five plans shipped (sn-pipeline-recovery, sn-dd-gaps, dd-version-resilient-resolution, and sn-repair-operator-consolidation's sprint clause); sn-graph-wide-integrity remains the sole open item. Three execution sessions have landed 34 nodes. The defining result is that this sprint's own orphan premise was overturned by measurement, twice, and both times a guard or a worker refusal is what made it visible. Forward regeneration genuinely cannot re-source the 36 orphans — compose re-emits parents and never proposes the children, established for $1.60 — but that negative was recorded as settling the general question, and reverse dictionary search finds measuring paths for 31 of the 36 with agreeing units. The all-delete cohort the earlier reading licensed would have destroyed correct vocabulary; nothing was deleted, because three independent guards had already refused on quarantine, relationship closure, and review-history permanence. The final partition is 31 attachable, 4 held on named DD defects, 1 retired on physics, and 0 deletable on no-measuring-path grounds. Applied against it: 15 exact attachments at untouched_changed=0 over 9,607 rows with a write-free replay, dropping genuine orphans 36 to 20; one axis retarget authorized by structural-child closure; electron_source_rate carried through ordinary review after its two blocking defects were fixed at their causes, turning two red graph integrity tests green; four of seven identities accepted on a single corrected-grammar draw; and the voltage identity closed as a standing recorded refusal with both routes shut by measurement. Four live-graph ratchets pass, grammar serves rc66 at 956 tokens, and accepted grammar failures are 0 of 2,532. Alongside, the repair-operator programme moved from one migrated operator to three, all three previously untestable operators gained disposable-graph suites written against live code before migration, and a false-positive audit-check defect was fixed with each check still failing a genuine violation. Measured spend across the sprint remains a few dollars of the authorized $150, because every mechanical repair is deterministic and compose runs free on the local seat.

S8 restated against measurement after two execution sessions. Dual-bound 226 to 23, stale-with-binding 58 to 3, signed retirements 16 to 0, measurement-position producers 61 to 28, 11 identities accepted, spend $3.47 of $150. Regeneration was tried as the locked family-topology-repair decision prescribes and disproved for the orphans at a cost of $1.60: compose re-emits parents and never proposes the orphan children, so their disposition is retirement rather than re-sourcing. Root-caused and fixed a stale grammar snapshot serving rc9 under a string-ordered version fallback while rc66 was pinned, with ISN's graph spec omitting 175 public physical_base tokens. Landed live-graph ratchets for three previously unasserted invariant classes. Captured execution doctrine in the plan and raised sn-repair-operator-consolidation and dd-version-resilient-resolution as separate plans.

Two authority decisions. Names never approved through a catalog pull request are DELETED rather than retired when they lose their home, since retirement exists to preserve a published identity and superseding an unreleased name leaves residue in a catalog it never entered; of the 36 orphans only 3 carry catalog-edit origin, so the great majority simply go. And dd-version-resilient-resolution joins S8 rather than sitting in backlog, because a dictionary label mismatch already halted a scoped run and 8,680 sources still carry an older label, so every future bump repeats the stop until resolution compares content instead of labels.

Delete authority narrowly bounded after the lead flagged that the delete-not-retire wording read broadly enough to licence deleting most of the graph, since only a few hundred of 2,538 accepted names are released. Deletion now requires all four of no producing source, no live structural child, no catalog release provenance, and membership in an exact signed manifest whose row count the operator refuses on excess; and it may never be triggered by a parse failure, grammar mismatch, quarantine, validation error or resolution fault. The stale rc9 grammar defect is the cautionary case: had deletion been reachable from a parse failure, it would have manufactured justification for destroying correct names. Separately sn-repair-operator-consolidation moved from backlog into S8 after its own trigger fired via the delete mutation kind, and after correction showed the target is ten signed-artifact operators migrated one at a time rather than 22 behind an all-or-nothing switch.

S8 session landed 15 nodes with 3 fail-closed refusals and zero unintended writes. dd-version-resilient-resolution SHIPPED: the fix was deleting four lines, because the convergence primitive already sat in the same module behind a pre-emptive label guard, and the larger half made batch refusal per-leaf across all 7 call sites, one of which paired rows to results positionally and would have misassociated them silently. sn-repair-operator-consolidation met its done_when and stays active with 9 operators unmigrated: one authority schema validates all 4 committed artifacts from original bytes at pinned digests, apply_signed_manifest carries the eight-step envelope with 9 of 9 disposable-graph proofs and exact refusal strings, and the first bespoke operator is deleted with zero remaining references while its suite ran unchanged. All four sn-graph-wide-integrity ratchets now pass: reconciliation no longer rebinds stale sources, the 2 rebound edges were detached with 9,614 untouched-row digests unchanged, and the interrupted momentum-flux run reached a decided exhausted lifecycle for $0.66. But that plan's done_when is NOT met, because the lead overturned the orphan disposition: asked whether the 36 unsourced names could be re-sourced by reverse dictionary search before removal, the answer is 25 RECOVERABLE, 3 genuine negatives, 8 needing physics judgement, with j_ohmic 0.94, grid/area 0.92 and q_min/value 0.89 all unit-matching. The all-delete cohort would have destroyed 25 valuable names whose only defect was a lost binding. The earlier negative result had tested composition FORWARD only, where compose re-emits parents and never proposes these children; a negative in one direction was read as a negative in every direction. Nothing was deleted - three independent guards had already refused on quarantine, on relationship closure, and on review/chain-history permanence. Also landed: a composer that could not spell canonically now normalizes to the parser's canonical order, admitting 55 segment combinations beyond the one that surfaced it; the manifest digest the ledger already wrote is declared; pre-existing lint debt cleared. Spend $0.66 of $150.

S8 session landed 19 nodes with 4 recorded fail-closed or not-run refusals and zero unintended writes, and its central result is that this sprint's own done_when was wrong. Reverse dictionary search recovers 31 of the 36 unsourced names with agreeing units, including the last 3 that had survived a negative search: those were false negatives from a query ranking only its top eight paths, while each response had already returned the cluster holding the missed family. So zero of the 36 is deletable on no-measuring-path grounds, and the sprint clause instructing deletion was corrected in place. A governed transaction then attached 15 of 31 candidates at untouched_changed=0 over 9,607 rows with a write-free replay, dropping genuine orphans 36 to 20; unit guards agreed on all 31 and were never the binding constraint, as target lifecycle refused 9 of the 16. electron_source_rate went through ordinary review at $0.197 once its two blocking defects were fixed at their causes rather than retried, turning two red graph integrity tests green. One axis retarget applied under a structural-child closure the coordinator authorized after the worker correctly refused to widen its own guard. Four of seven identities accepted on a single corrected-grammar draw at $0.56, three of them grammar-preferred spellings that had scored 0.76 to 0.84 against the stale vocabulary. The voltage identity closed as a standing recorded refusal with both sanctioned routes shut by measurement. Alongside, the repair-operator programme went from one migrated operator to three, all three previously untestable operators gained disposable-graph suites written against live code before migration, and four codex audit checks that were quarantining legitimate names were given precision while each still fails a genuine violation. The reusable lesson is about negatives: a negative result must state which direction it tested and how far down it looked, and the plan's cheap-experiment doctrine now carries that qualification.
